blocks.text: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Tuesday called out China for what its “inconsistent” position on international law, saying Beijing claims to recognize the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) but refuses to accept the 2016 arbitral ruling on the South China Sea.
